title: Folders group your work across every product
summary: Folders across every product, audio-only and 4K exports, Microsoft Translator for memories, Drive files as inputs and a User Actions log.

sections.title: Folders
sections.note: Group work from every product in one folder, with a matching Drive folder.

items.body: File Translate Video, Translate Photo, QC and Cosmos work together
Pick a folder when you start work, or use **Move to folder**
Export audio only as a WAV file
Tick **Export with issues** to export despite transcript issues
Video and audio exports keep separate histories

sections.title: Microsoft Translator for memories
sections.note: VitraTM memories can translate with Azure instead of Gemini.

items.body: Add the Translator key and region under **Settings → AI Keys**
Exact memory matches still apply on both engines
Set review status on up to 500 translations at once
Use files already in Drive as inputs across products
See who did what in **Settings → User Actions**
Scope or filter a proofreading report by folder
Invoice PDFs show full language names
Moving between Asset Manager folders no longer crashes the page
Quick Create no longer wipes your first message
Profile language rates refresh right after an edit
Notifications appear on top of other content
Permission checks no longer block subtitle export and sync
